company.name: Orbii AI
company.shortDescription: Orbii AI develops an artificial intelligence-based credit assessment tool for optimal loan decisions.
company.description:
Orbii is a fintech infrastructure company focused on making business credit fairer, faster, and more accessible across the MENA region.

The company was created to address the limitations of traditional credit systems and fragmented data environments by building its own end-to-end credit infrastructure. Orbii develops modular credit models, explainable decision-making systems, and rapid integration tools that enable fintech companies to launch and scale lending products efficiently.

Today, Orbii supports more than 19 fintech teams across the GCC and broader region, powering credit solutions that have served over 5,000 businesses. Its platform emphasizes customer experience and operational simplicity, allowing partners to deploy scalable credit products with minimal technical overhead and without the need to build in-house credit operations teams.

By combining automation, scalable infrastructure, and transparent underwriting technology, Orbii helps fintechs accelerate growth while expanding financial access for underserved businesses across MENA.
